changelog:
Major simplification and refocus of documentation and codebase.

- Overhauled SKILL.md to concise, bullet-pointed Chinese/English hybrid overview.
- Reduced project footprint by removing 120 files, including runtime specs, UI scripts, configs, and auxiliary docs.
- Streamlined feature set: cognitive loop, memory graph, JSON persistence, one-click clear, Python stdlib, static UI.
- Updated quick start instructions and API list.
- Emphasized zero-dependency core and local-first operation.
summary: CNexus 2.0 — local personal second brain. 6-step cognitive loop, memory graph, JSON persistence, one-click clear. Python stdlib + static UI.
